messages:
jamal: Quick heads-up — savings plan / RI renewal decision for GPU fleet due next Friday. We need to decide coverage for p4d/p3dn in us-west-2 and g5 in eu-west-1. Can ops + finance weigh in? @maria @alex

mar ia: Can you drop current utilization numbers? RI utilization and coverage %?

billing-bot: Auto-report: RI/Savings Plan snapshot
Total committed (monthly): $142,000
EC2 RI utilization: 78%
EC2 RI coverage: 42%
GPU-specific RIs (p4/p3/g5) utilization: 64%, unused RI hours: 18,200
Potential monthly savings moving 20% to Compute Savings Plans: ~$9,300

billing-bot: Quick command we used:
```bash
aws ce get-savings-plans-utilization --time-period Start=2026-02-01,End=2026-02-28
```

alex: We have underused p3 capacity in eu-west-1 because traffic shifted to p4 in us-west-2. Suggest we avoid renewing standard RIs for p3; consider convertible RIs or Compute Savings Plans where possible. Note: Savings Plans give more family/region flexibility for general compute but GPU family coverage is limited — model-level check needed.

tina: Finance note: current RI term expiring 2026-04-30. Renewal asks:
- Total renewal list price (1yr): $1.1M/year
- Option A: re-up standard RIs (1yr) — low admin, lower flexibility
- Option B: 3yr Compute Savings Plan (no instance size restrictions) — commit $600k/year, est 22% savings vs on-demand
We'll produce NPV comparison + cash-flow impact. :money_with_wings:

jamal: Action items:
1) eng-infra (alex/jamal) -> produce per-instance-type 12mo utilization by region CSV
2) finance (tina) -> run SP vs RI cost model incl. partial-upfront vs no-upfront
3) SRE -> flag upcoming capacity migration windows (we have planned node refreshes Apr 10-14)
Deadline: Tue COB. I'll attach the billing export query below.

jamal: Billing export query:
```sql
SELECT instance_type, region, SUM(usage_hours) AS used_hours, SUM(reserved_hours) AS reserved_hours
FROM billing.aws_cost_and_usage
WHERE product = 'AmazonEC2'
GROUP BY instance_type, region
ORDER BY instance_type;
```

alex: Roger. I'll run the script, upload CSV to #eng-infra-output, and include a diff vs last quarter. +1 on avoiding 3yr standard RIs for GPUs unless utilization proves stable.

maria: Can we also compare partial-upfront vs no-upfront options? Our cash prefers no-upfront but if savings are big we could consider partial.

tina: Will model both, include payback period and break-even.

jamal: Thanks all — ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
